resolved_config.prompt_text:
NO BACKGROUND MUSIC. Natural diegetic sound effects only.

MANDATORY AUDIO: absolute silence except one tiny dry physical cloth SFX when cloth actually moves. Each cue ends within0.125seconds; all time between cues and all held poses are completely silent. ZERO MUSIC throughout opening, cuts, ending and tail. No score, melody, beat, percussion, pulse, drone, riser, sting, ambience bed, sustained tone, human voice, singing, narration, speech or lip sync.

Create8 rapid hard-cut vertical ChronoStick shots at24fps,480×864. Complete the entire sequence within the first6.875seconds (165frames). Remaining10engineframes are exclusively a motionless final-mask hold. All stated times are local from the first frame. No new story action during that extra hold. Do not reorder the shots or add an unlisted flashback.

Every pixel remains detailed illustrated stick-world: simple round heads, sparse face marks, slim limbs, controlled dark outlines, muted hoodie clothes, matte drawn stone/wood/plants/sky, warm amber left light and cool slate right shadows. No photograph, realistic skin, glossy3D, grid, panels, labels, logos or readable text. At most one tiny action per shot, fixed camera.

<Picture 1> controls exactly three modern masked hoodie figures in the drawn sunset plaza: charcoal center closest, slate-blue left behind, burgundy right behind. Same flat-roof buildings, paving and low shrubs. Each wears one rigid ivory mask with black PAINTED brows, black EMPTY eye holes, curled black PAINTED moustache, pointed PAINTED goatee and rose PAINTED cheeks. Masks are inanimate props: absolutely no eyelids, eyeballs, eye blinking, moving mouths, lip shapes, facial morphing or living facial expressions. All mask paint stays perfectly fixed; the central figure can move head only slightly. No historical man or costume appears anywhere in this clip.

<Picture 2> controls only an EMPTY illustrated barrel undercroft: closed oak barrels, dark iron hoops, stone arch/floor, zero people, hands, clothing or faces. Use only its static barrel crops in the two prescribed retrospective shots. No flame, fuse, smoke, exposed powder, ignition or explosion.

<Picture 3> controls exactly one hand-held ivory painted mask and one pale charcoal-cuffed holding hand against drawn slate wall; no wearer or historic costume. Same rigid fixed painted features; its black eye holes never blink.

HARD CUT C06-S01: 0.000000–1.000000s; frames0–23. Wide modern plaza and three distinct masked figures. Exactly three hoodie adults: blue left behind, charcoal/blue-gray center closest, burgundy right behind; exactly one worn mask each; modern flat-roof blocks/paving, no crowd. Hold the explicit objects and count; no added movement or camera zoom. Masks stay completely rigid and unblinking. Retrospective barrel shots are ALWAYS empty.

HARD CUT C06-S02: 1.000000–1.250000s; frames24–29. Very brief central worn-mask close crop. Exactly one central charcoal-hooded mask face in crop; side roles outside frame; no mouth movement or mask duplication. Hold the explicit objects and count; no added movement or camera zoom. Masks stay completely rigid and unblinking. Retrospective barrel shots are ALWAYS empty.

HARD CUT C06-S03: 1.250000–2.083333s; frames30–49. Retrospective closed barrel crop, objects only. Only closed barrel wood/hoops and stone; zero people, hands, clothing, fire or smoke; no revived character. Hold the explicit objects and count; no added movement or camera zoom. Masks stay completely rigid and unblinking. Retrospective barrel shots are ALWAYS empty.

HARD CUT C06-S04: 2.083333–2.708333s; frames50–64. Tighter intact barrel hoop/lid detail. One existing dry barrel and hoop; no people, damage or ignition; continuation of same object-only retrospective insert. Hold the explicit objects and count; no added movement or camera zoom. Masks stay completely rigid and unblinking. Retrospective barrel shots are ALWAYS empty.

HARD CUT C06-S05: 2.708333–3.541667s; frames65–84. One hand-held modern mask, echo of opening. One ivory/black/rose mask and one pale charcoal-cuffed hand against slate wall; no wearer or historical costume. Hold the explicit objects and count; no added movement or camera zoom. Masks stay completely rigid and unblinking. Retrospective barrel shots are ALWAYS empty.

HARD CUT C06-S06: 3.541667–4.416667s; frames85–105. Hard-cut wider trio: one symbol carried by several people. Exactly charcoal central, blue left and burgundy right hoodie adults, one mask each; same contemporary plaza; nobody appears or disappears during shot. Hold the explicit objects and count; no added movement or camera zoom. Masks stay completely rigid and unblinking. Retrospective barrel shots are ALWAYS empty.

HARD CUT C06-S07: 4.416667–5.208333 seconds; frames106–124. A close object-only crop of the same detached mask prop from Picture3: one pale charcoal-cuffed hand holds its edge against the drawn slate wall. No wearer, hood, person or living face is visible. Painted black eye HOLES stay empty and fixed; the object cannot blink. Hold the hand and prop perfectly still.

HARD CUT C06-S08: 5.208333–6.875000 seconds; frames125–164. Resolved front-facing DETACHED hand-held mask object, same image authority as Picture3 and the opening of the video. One ivory rigid painted mask fills the center, one pale charcoal-cuffed hand visible only at its outer lower edge. Zero worn masks, hoods, heads or faces in this final shot. Rigid black eye holes, fixed paint, no anatomy behind them. Entire mask and hand remain perfectly motionless. This final prop composition deliberately rhymes with the opening for a replay loop.

At6.875seconds the final frontal detached hand-held mask PROP is already motionless. Hold exactly that final composition through the extra10frames. The single existing edge-holding hand stays still; no new hand enters, no blinking, no morph or new cut. Absolutely zero music, no cut sound accents, no speech. Silence except the tiny physical cue, and complete silence throughout the final hold.
